statement.name: GetFolders
statement.sql:
WITH folders AS ( SELECT lpf.[FolderId] , lpf.[FolderName] , isnull(replace(convert(VARCHAR(MAX), esdv.DimensionValue) + rtrim(ltrim(pcpdp.RelativeURL)), '{0}', ''),'#') as NevigationUrl , rlpfar.RoleId , rlpfar.Hierarchy , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY lpf.FolderId ORDER BY rlpfar.Hierarchy DESC, rlpfar.RoleId DESC) AS FolderRank , lpf.DisplayOrder FROM [LU_PFM_Folders] lpf join [Rel_LU_PFM_Folder_AC_Role] rlpfar on lpf.FolderId = rlpfar.FolderId join PFM_CORE_PreDefinedPage pcpdp on lpf.COREPreDefinedPageId = pcpdp.COREPreDefinedPageId join dbo.ExternalSystemDimensionValue esdv on pcpdp.ExternalSystemDimensionCode = esdv.ExternalSystemDimensionCode AND pcpdp.ExternalSystemCode = esdv.ExternalSystemCode join AC_RelUserRole r on r.RoleId = rlpfar.RoleId
) SELECT f.FolderId, f.FolderName, f.NevigationUrl, f.RoleId [Role], f.DisplayOrder FROM folders f WHERE f.FolderRank = 1 ORDER BY f.DisplayOrder
